101C token review
Add source links and UTC check times to each entry.

Token and check time
Chain, full token address, launch mode, and UTC check time.


Wallets and holdings
Owner, units, confirmed links, suspected links, supply total used, and transaction sources.


Supply and allocations
Total units, pool reserves, locked units, available holder units, and sources.


Creator permissions
Mint, freeze, fee, transfer, and upgrade controls; controller/status and sources.


Locks and next releases
Contract, beneficiary, claimable units, next amount/date/timezone, and change rights.


Pools and sale quotes
Pair, pool, liquidity controller, lock coverage/expiry, quote size, proceeds, impact, and time.


Creator earnings
Fee rule/source, recipient, earned-but-waiting and received amounts, claims, sales, and spending evidence.


Buyer activity and catalyst
Equal windows, pool coverage, group/other buying, primary sources, and competitors.


Group transaction ledger
Opening holdings + purchases + outside inflows - sales - outside outflows = closing holdings. Internal transfers cancel.


Creator work and buyer response
Dated delivery, promotion, disclosure, spending, buyer activity, and source links.


Previous launches
Contracts, team-link confidence, promises, delivery, sales, and outcomes.


Unanswered questions
Missing history, uncertain links, unknown controllers, stale data, and needed evidence.


Conclusion and next check
Separate demand and supply statuses, your screening limit, and what to check next with date/time.
